cover.sub: MAPS · GUNS · MODES · BUFFS · DMZ X01

slides.title: 3 NEW MAPS

cards.name: Backstab
cards.desc: Snowy, war-torn town with abandoned tanks. Snipers: Stronghold House roof + Sniper House.

cards.name: Canyon
cards.desc: Sun-scorched canyon with tall rock walls: River, Cliff Path, Cave and a central Mesa.

cards.name: Shoot House
cards.desc: The classic 3-lane map, now in snowy North Korea.

slides.foot: MID-SEASON: MINISTRY + OVERFLOW · SHIPMENT IS ALREADY LIVE

slides.sec: BOTH FREE IN THE BATTLE PASS
slides.title: 2 NEW GUNS

cards.name: Cronen Osprey
cards.desc: 882 RPM, 30 rounds: best-in-class fire rate. Apex: Helix Mk. II (dual-fire).

cards.name: CSG-35
cards.desc: 1200 RPM, 28 rounds, dual-wield akimbo. Apex: CSG Crossfire.

cards.name: JAK 12
cards.desc: Full-auto shotgun. Apex: JAK Barrage (sticky explosives).

slides.title: NEW + RETURNING MODES

cards.name: Grind
cards.desc: Collect enemy dog tags and bank them at one of 2 Banks. Die = you drop every tag you carry.

cards.name: Drop Zone
cards.desc: Hold one rotating objective. Airdrops give your team random killstreaks.

cards.name: Gauntlet 1v1
cards.desc: 1v1 Gunfight: wager trophies, the winner stays for the next opponent.

slides.foot: ALSO: KILL BLOCK "CRASH" COMBO · COUNTER ATTACK AT MID-SEASON

cards.name: Crossfire
cards.desc: Bullet damage -50%, radius -25%, adds spawn protection.

slides.title: X01 BLACK SITE
rules: GRANIT Arms facility under Hajin: tunnels, labs, a sealed Deep Vault.
Knuckle + The Wrench (Lieutenants), The Captain (Juggernaut Commander).
Exfils close one by one. Always know your nearest exfil.
Supplied Drops on Dynamic Op crates: extra container 25% → 50%.

slides.title: BATTLE PASS
rules: 100 tiers in a straight line, 100+ rewards.
Premium owners who fall behind jump to the current day's reward, up to day 50.

cta.sub: BACKSTAB, CANYON, SHOOT HOUSE OR X01?
